name: mailari-travels-crm
description: Mailari Travels — Complete Travel & Fleet Management Platform

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
